payload.title: Knowledge run and Cited Trends: safe and fast daily or on demand
payload.description: Weekly is too slow while iterating. Three changes: (1) trend-drafts freshness accepts a daily or manual run (snapshot asOf = start date, within TREND_DRAFTS_MAX_AGE_DAYS, or the Monday the snapshot stage writes), plus configurable trend windows in days (default 28); (2) operator IAM read of story_draft Proposals (id, title, summary, targets, state, createdAt) so ideas trends dedupes under IAM, plus an anchor-entity cooldown (default 7 days); (3) incremental, idempotent monitor-record import (content-hash ledger in the run state bucket, parallel writes), target: minutes with no new records. Shipped's schedule is not changed here.
